fields.name: Politics
fields.description: Debates on political systems, policies, and government.

fields.name: Technology
fields.description: Debates on the impact of technology and artificial intelligence.

fields.name: Environment
fields.description: Debates on climate change, sustainability, and environmental policy.

fields.name: Society & Ethics
fields.description: Debates on social issues, morality, and human rights.

fields.name: Economy & Business
fields.description: Debates on economic systems, trade, and business practices.

fields.title: Should voting be mandatory for all citizens?
fields.description: Compulsory voting increases participation but raises questions about freedom of choice.

fields.title: Should the death penalty be abolished worldwide?
fields.description: Capital punishment as justice versus its ethical and practical implications.

fields.title: Should term limits be imposed on all elected officials?
fields.description: Term limits prevent entrenchment of power but may remove experienced leaders.

fields.title: Should social media platforms be regulated by governments?
fields.description: Balancing free speech against the harms of misinformation and hate speech online.

fields.title: Should AI development be paused until safety is guaranteed?
fields.description: Rapid AI advancement poses existential risks that may outpace our ability to control it.

fields.title: Should autonomous weapons be banned internationally?
fields.description: Lethal AI weapons change the nature of warfare and accountability in conflict.

fields.title: Does social media do more harm than good to society?
fields.description: Connectivity and information access weighed against addiction, polarisation, and mental health.

fields.title: Should genetic engineering of humans be permitted?
fields.description: Designer babies and gene therapy raise profound ethical and social questions.

fields.title: Should nuclear energy be part of the green energy transition?
fields.description: Nuclear power is low-carbon but carries risks of accidents and waste disposal.

fields.title: Should meat consumption be taxed to reduce carbon emissions?
fields.description: Animal agriculture is a major climate driver — should governments price it accordingly?

fields.title: Should rich nations pay reparations to poorer ones for climate damage?
fields.description: Historical emissions from wealthy countries disproportionately affect vulnerable nations.

fields.title: Should euthanasia be legalised?
fields.description: The right to die with dignity versus the sanctity of life and risks of abuse.

fields.title: Should all drugs be decriminalised?
fields.description: Portugal's model shows decriminalisation can reduce harm — should the world follow?

fields.title: Should affirmative action be used in university admissions?
fields.description: Correcting historical inequality versus merit-based selection principles.

fields.title: Is cancel culture a threat to free speech?
fields.description: Social accountability versus mob mentality and the chilling effect on expression.

fields.title: Should a universal basic income be implemented?
fields.description: UBI promises financial security for all but raises questions about funding and work incentives.

fields.title: Should billionaires exist?
fields.description: Extreme wealth concentration versus the argument that it drives innovation and growth.

fields.title: Should the gig economy be more strictly regulated?
fields.description: Flexibility for workers versus exploitation and lack of labour protections.

fields.title: Should cryptocurrency be banned?
fields.description: Digital currencies challenge financial systems while enabling speculation and illicit activity.
